children.counts: Even 8-count beats: 4 beats of arm winding, 4 beats of dramatic posing.
children.game_version: Freeze Fame: kids perform continuous arm rolls to disco music and freeze instantly into movie superhero or star poses when the track stops.

seniors.counts: 4-count slow arm wraps followed by 4-count holding poses.
seniors.seated_version: Perform arm circles, wrist rolls, and dramatic diva head-and-hand poses from a stable upright chair.
seniors.standing_version: Stationary standing practice focusing exclusively on shoulder mobility, arm framing, and upper-body poses without fast floor travel.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce disco track speed to 80-90 BPM; keep arm sweeps below shoulder level if overhead mobility is restricted.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Rapid rotational arm movements, wrist isolations, and over-the-head whacks coordinated with musical accents
movement_profile.footwork: Rhythmic stepping and weight shifts supporting torso orientation, influenced by jazz and club social steps
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo cypher center, moving dynamically within an intimate personal sphere or across a performance stage
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Sensual, dynamic torso lines with rhythmic rib isolations and fluid hip shifts
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Primarily danced upright, incorporating low floor lunges, drops, and dynamic level changes during dramatic musical breaks
movement_profile.partnering: Primarily solo freestyle; in battles, dancers face each other dialogically; staged synchronization in choreographies
movement_profile.posture: Upright, proud, theatrical spine with an open chest, projecting diva glamour and continuous eye contact

signature_moves.description: An explosive movement of the forearm and hand driving up and over the head in strict musical rhythm
signature_moves.name: The Whack

signature_moves.description: Dramatic, frozen attitudes channeling vintage Hollywood film stars with stylized hand and head placement
signature_moves.name: Posing

signature_moves.description: Continuous circular loops of the forearms around the head, shoulders, and chest without breaking tempo
signature_moves.name: Rotational Arm Rolls

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Urgent, driving, and razor-sharp, maintaining fluid arm circles between instantaneous frozen accents
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not execute arm rolls without shoulder warming; avoid disconnecting arm movement from musical phrasing or facial expression

music_profile.musical_form: Verse-chorus structure with extended instrumental dance breaks and dynamic percussion builds
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Driving four-on-the-floor kick with upbeat open hi-hats and accented syncopated brass and string stabs
music_profile.sound_description: High-octane 1970s disco and post-disco characterized by a relentless four-on-the-floor beat, syncopated basslines, and soaring orchestral strings. The music delivers dramatic brass accents and vocal peaks that cue sharp, sudden arm hits and frozen poses.
music_profile.vocal_style: Dramatic, soulful disco vocals and diva hooks, expressive and high-energy

basic_steps: Arm Whack: rhythmic strike bringing forearm and hand sharply over the head
Rotational Overhead Sweep: continuous circular winding of arms around the crown and neck
Hollywood Diva Pose: sudden frozen stylized silhouette imitating classic film screen actors
Rhythmic Extension: extending arms explosively outward to music accents before returning to overhead rotation
teaching.formation: Individual freestyle circles, battle cyphers, and staged choreographic group formations
teaching.level_notes: Beginners isolate elbow and wrist rotations slowly before accelerating to 120+ BPM disco speeds and integrating full-body posing
teaching.rhythm: Fast 4/4 disco and post-disco pulse, emphasizing sharp syncopated hits on downbeats and snare snaps
